name: Frisco
housing: Frisco's rentals are mostly newer single-family houses in HOA communities and large new apartment complexes.

climate: Test the air conditioning, photograph the roof for hail damage and look for foundation cracks; summers are hot and spring hail is common.
fact: Frisco is one of the fastest-growing cities in the country, so many rentals are recently built.
